name: Work-Based Learning (CTAE), Atlanta Public Schools
org: Atlanta Public Schools, Career, Technical and Agricultural Education (CTAE)
what_you_do: Learn job skills in the community while you earn high school credit. Work-based learning connects your class work to real work experience.
who_can_apply: Atlanta Public Schools students. The district page does not list grade, age or GPA rules, so ask your school counselor or the CTAE office.
pay_detail: Not stated on the district page. You earn high school credit.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page.
how_to_apply: The page does not give steps. Call or email the Work-Based Learning contact, or ask your school counselor.
notes: The phone on the page is (404) 802-5878. The page also lists CTAE career paths. They include Engineering Drafting, Allied Health, Cybersecurity and Culinary Arts. Students in other districts use their own district.
